summary: Session initiation is rejected when the counterparty DID is outside the mandate allow-list. Documented gap: `allowed_counterparties` is not a field of the declared (Tier 1) mandate in spec §5.3, and neither reference server enforces a counterparty allow-list, so this is not rejected today.

expect.reason: Intended behavior once a counterparty allow-list is defined in the mandate schema and enforced; not enforced by the current reference servers.
